tech.objective_subtitle: Kushandisa hungwaru hweArtificial Intelligence (AI) nehunyanzvi hwedhijitari kubatanidza Zimbabwe nevanhu vayo vari kunze kwenyika, kuitira kukurudzira kushanda pamwe chete, budiriro inogara, nekukura kwehupfumi kwenguva refu.
tech.onesa_desc1: Onesa AI imuchina wedu wakagadzirwa kuti ujekese nzira yekurarama, kudyara mari, nekubudirira muZimbabwe. Kunyangwe AI dzinowanzoitika kune dzimwe nyika dzichishaya ruzivo rwemuno, Onesa yakavakirwa pakuonzwisisa mamiriro eZimbabwe kudarika chero upi zvake muchina.
tech.onesa_desc2: Kubva pakuziva mitemo yemuno kusvika pakuronga mazano emabhizimusi anogadzirisa matambudziko eZimbabwe, Onesa inokupa ungwaru hwaunoda kuti ubudirire.
tech.onesa_local_edge_desc: Dzimwe AI dzinogona kugona mune zveupfumi hune mitemo yakanyorwa, asi dzinokundikana munyaya dze 'kukiya-kiya' dzekuMbare Musika kana kunzwisisa chidhori chechiShona chakavhenganiswa nechiNdebele.
tech.diaspora_unlocked_desc: Tinoshandisa ruzivo rwemazuva ano kuti ushanyi, kutengeserana, nekudyara mari kuve nyore. Dandira redu rinobatanidza vana vari kunze nemikana yemuno kuburikidza nekujekesa zvinhu neAI.
tech.ai_demo_question: Ndeipi mikana yekudyara mari mune zvekurima muZimbabwe ine mhindu yakakura iye zvino?
tech.ai_demo_response: Chikamu chekurima muZimbabwe chiri kuratidza kukura mune zvekutengesa kunze. Kudyara mari muzvokutakura zvinhu zvinoda kutonhorerwa (cold-chain) zveblueberries kubva kuEastern Highlands kune mhindu yakakura...
tech.features_subtitle: Zvishandiso zvakagadzirwa kuvhara gwanza pakati pevana vari kunze nemikana yemuno.
tech.cta_desc: Joinha chirongwa chedu chebeta uve wekutanga kuona ungwaru hweOnesa AI huri pamusoro peZimbabwe.
tech.sectors_subtitle: Onesa AI inopa ruzivo rwakakosha kusimudzira zvikamu zveupfumi hweZimbabwe zvinokosha.

requirements: Kupaka kunofanira kutevera mitemo yeEU yezvibereko zvitsva.
Kuve nenzira dzakanaka dzekutakura nekuomesa (cold storage) kwakakosha.
Chitupa cheOrganic chinopa mutengo wakanaka kwazvo.

Chitupa cheCOSMOS kana NaTrue kuitira zvekuzvizora.

vicfalls.name: Victoria Falls
vicfalls.desc: Chimwe chezvishamiso zvinomwe zvenyika, mapopoma makuru pasi rose
vicfalls.summary: Inozivikanwa nemuno seMosi-oa-Tunya (Utsi Hunotinhira), Victoria Falls yakapetwa kaviri pakukwirira kune Niagara Falls. Nakidzwa nekukwira magwa, bungee jumping, nhabvu dzemundege, uye Devil's Pool inozivikanwa kwazvo.

greatzim.name: Great Zimbabwe
greatzim.desc: Masvingo ekare anoratidza budiriro nehunyanzvi hwekuvaka hweAfrica
greatzim.summary: Yakavakwa pakati pezana ramakore rechi11 nerechi15, Great Zimbabwe ndiyo yaive guta guru reUmambo hweZimbabwe. Masvingo aya akavakwa nemabwe pasina dhaka. Nzvimbo iyi ndiyo yakapa nyika zita rayo.

kariba.name: Dhamu reKariba
kariba.desc: Rimwe remadziva makuru akaitwa nevanhu, rakanakira kukwira magwa nekuredza hove
kariba.summary: Dziva reKariba rakakura kudarika 5,500 square kilometers parwizi rwaZambezi. Rakakurumbira nekuredza tiger fish, maholide emagwa (houseboats), nekuvira kwezuva kunoyevedza.

rocks.name: Mabwe Anoshamisa
rocks.summary: Mabwe aya anoonekwa pamari yeZimbabwe uye anowanikwa munyika yose, zvikuru muMatobo National Park. Akasikwa nemamiriro ekunze mukufamba kwemakore akawanda.

tourism.other_attractions_subtitle: Kunze kwenzvimbo dzinozivikanwa, Zimbabwe ine sango nemhuka zvakasiyana-siyana.

hwange.name: Sango reHwange
hwange.desc: Sango guru muZimbabwe, rinozivikanwa nemombe dzenzou dzakawanda.
hwange.summary: Rine nharaunda inodarika 14,000 square kilometers, Hwange inzvimbo yepamusoro yeSafari. Ine mhuka dzinoyamwisa dzinodarika zana nemarudzi eshiri mana mazana.

matobo.name: Sango reMatobo
matobo.desc: Nzvimbo yeUNESCO inozivikanwa nemabwe akaturikidzana nenhoroondo dzemweya.
matobo.summary: Matobo Hills ine mifananidzo yemabwe yakanyorwa nemaSan kare kwazvo uye ndiko kune guva raCecil John Rhodes pa 'World's View'.

eastern_highlands.name: Eastern Highlands
eastern_highlands.desc: Nzvimbo inotonhorera ine makomo, masango anoyevedza, nemapopoma.
eastern_highlands.summary: Dunhu riri pamuganhu weMozambique, rinosanganisira makomo eNyanga, Vumba, neChimanimani.

mana_pools.name: Sango reMana Pools
mana_pools.desc: Nzvimbo yeUNESCO inozivikanwa nemadziva emurwizi uye safari dzekufamba netsoka.
mana_pools.summary: Inowanikwa muZambezi Valley, Mana Pools inozivikanwa nekunaka kwayo nemadziva mana makuru akaitwa nerwizi.

nyanga.name: Sango reNyanga
nyanga.desc: Gomo refu muZimbabwe nemapopoma akadzika kwazvo.
nyanga.summary: Nyanga inzvimbo inoyevedza ine Gomo reNyangani neMutarazi Falls (mapopoma echipiri pakureba muAfrica).

gonarezhou.name: Sango reGonarezhou
gonarezhou.desc: 'Nzvimbo dzenzou,' inozivikanwa nemawere matsvuku eChilojo Cliffs.
gonarezhou.summary: Sango rechipiri pakukura muZimbabwe, rinozivikanwa nemawere emabwe matsvuku (sandstone cliffs). Inopa mukana wekuona sango chairo.

onesa.name: Onesa AI
onesa.title: Gwara rako Remuno muhomwe mako
onesa.subtitle: Kufamba muZimbabwe kunogona kuita kunetsa. Onesa AI inonzwisisa hupfumi hwe 'kukiya-kiya' nezvose zvinoitika muno.
onesa.companion_title: Kubva pakubhadhara ndege, mamiriro ekunze kana kutsvaga nzvimbo dzakanaka, Onesa AI inokubatsira
onesa.companion_subtitle: Onesa AI inokubatsira kuronga rwendo nekuziva mafambisirwo ezvinhu kana wasvika. Kubva pakuita tsika nemagariro kusvika pakutsvaga nzvimbo dzakanaka dzakavandika.
onesa.prompt_question: "Onesa, ndeipi nzvimbo yakanaka yemuno yekudya Sadza chairo muHarare manheru ano?"
onesa.prompt_response: Kuti uwane Sadza chairo muHarare, enda kuMbare Musika. Vatengesi vemo vanopa Sadza rinopisa nezvitshebo zvakasiyana-siyana. Inzvimbo inodiwa kwazvo nemuno uye inopa kuravira chaiko kwezvekudya zveZimbabwe. Ingokumbira 'Sadza neNyama' kuitira chikafu chinoguta!
